project.name: frontend-services-damanich-laundry
project.description: Next.js 15 App Router frontend for Damanich Laundry operations dashboard and auth flows.

stack.dataLayer: Axios apiClient with cookie-based JWT auth

modules.name: Auth Guard + Hooks
flow: useAuth polls cookies, decodes JWT, exposes auth state
withAuth HOC redirects unauthenticated users to /auth/login

modules.name: API Layer
flow: apiClient attaches JWT from cookies on each request
401 responses purge cookies and navigate to /auth/login

modules.name: Dashboard UI Modules
modules.notes: Page-level components compose smaller module components (tables, forms, stats, headers). MyModal wraps MUI Dialog for consistent modals.

modules.name: Mock Data Sources
modules.notes: Provides placeholder data for orders, customers, services, staffs, and dashboard stats. Replace with real API integration later.

dataFlows.name: Dashboard Overview
dataFlows.description: src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx renders stat cards, weekly revenue placeholder, latest orders list, and modal for adding orders using mockOrdersLegacy + mockOrderTableData.

dataFlows.name: CRUD Pages
dataFlows.description: Each domain (customers, orders, services, staffs) has list (/), create (/new), and edit (/edit/[id]) screens leveraging module components (forms/tables) and dummy data. Router navigation handles success/cancel actions.

dataFlows.name: Order Creation Flow
dataFlows.description: src/app/(dashboard)/orders/new/page.tsx wires OrderForm ref, uses mockCustomers/mockServices for selects, and submits to handleSubmit -> TODO placeholder for API -> redirect to /orders.

utilities.purpose: Parses human-readable (including Indonesian months) dates into ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings for consistent form/table display.

indexingNotes: Prioritize indexing src/app, src/components, src/hooks, src/services, src/datas, src/lib, and src/utils for code understanding.
node_modules, build artifacts, and public assets can be skipped (already ignored via git).
All business logic currently lives client-side; there is no server route.
Replace mock data with API calls by swapping datasource imports without touching UI modules.
